thread:
dalia: Heads-up — found a dev helper script that writes a service account key to ~/.local/dev-sa.json and prints the path in logs. Not in repo but might be on dev machines. @security-team any quick remediation? :eyes:

mike: thanks for flagging. can you paste the snippet or file name? also which project/sa?

dalia: snippet: `echo "writing key to $HOME/.local/dev-sa.json"` and then `cp /tmp/sa.json $HOME/.local/dev-sa.json` — sa is `redwood-dev-analytics@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` .. oops

security-bot: Automated leak scan triggered: matched pattern service account key file path in user dalia's repo helpers/dev-run.sh — risk HIGH. See internal leak-scan run: https://leak-scan/17745

jun: immediate steps: 1) revoke the key 2) confirm not checked into git 3) run git-secrets + truffleHog across recent commits 4) rotate/create new key with least privilege and store in Vault

mike: I can revoke now, which key id? do you have key fingerprint? If it's only local, still rotate.

dalia: i don't have key id, it was a copy from `gcloud iam service-accounts keys create /tmp/sa.json --iam-account=...` earlier today. I'll stop other dev machines. Can someone run `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=redwood-dev-analytics@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` and send key ids?

jun: running that now. command: 
``
gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=redwood-dev-analytics@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --format='json'
``

jun: found 3 keys, one created today. key ID: 9a7b3c4d. Revoking key 9a7b3c4d now.

mike: Thanks — I'll also add a temporary deny rule for that SA on prod buckets until we confirm no other exposure. :lock: 

dalia: sorry everyone. next steps for me: delete local copies, search my machine, run `git status` on helpers, and add `echo` lines remove. will follow postmortem checklist.

security-bot: Incident template created: INC-2026-0427. Remediation checklist: revoke keys, rotate, run org-wide secret scan, check audit logs for key usage, rotate any tokens used. Assigned to @jun and @dalia.

jun: quick policy note — don't log file paths for credential files. use ephemeral creds (Workload Identity / short-lived tokens) or Vault agent. For dev UX, we should ship a helper that uses `gcloud auth print-access-token` and caches in memory only.

mike: Agreed. I'll open a PR to merge helper -> switch to short-lived tokens + add pre-commit git-secrets. Ping me for code review.

dalia: PR number? i'll review asap.

mike: PR #412 on infra/dev-tools. includes pre-commit hook and updated docs.

dalia: done — removed local copies, ran `git-secrets` and `truffleHog`, nothing checked-in.

jun: Closing the immediate threat. Follow-up: add CI check to block commits that print file paths with 'sa.json' or regex sensitive patterns. Also add a note to the dev handbook.

mike: tagging @eng-ops for rollout of pre-commit hook org-wide.

security-bot: Audit log flagged no external API calls from key after creation timeframe. No evidence of exfil so far. Keep monitoring for 48h.

dalia: thanks all, will add steps to our retro. :bow:
